title: Seed supporting questions when defining an output
description:
I already know the sub-questions that matter and want to give them as a starting point for the optimizer to revise.

Current: ClassifierSpec has no tasks field (embedded_cyclotron.py:70-77); the store opens with ClassifierConfig(spec.task, rubric=seed) (:340), so supporting questions come only from the optimizer.

Desired: seed_tasks per output, fixed at store creation like _seed (:347-363).

Acceptance: seeded questions appear in the first request and feed the first ML model fit; the optimizer can replace them; reopening the store doesn't rewrite them.
